description: An account with no models list refuses a model its provider's catalog does not have, without calling the upstream.

exceptions.reason: The old core answers an unknown model with 400 (unknown provider); the new core answers 404, as for any model no account serves.
For an unknown model the old core answers in OpenAI's error shape (model_not_found, unknown provider) even to a Gemini client; the new core answers in Gemini's shape that no account serves the model.

want.message: no account serves model "corpus-not-in-catalog". pluxy serves: gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-flash-lite, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-3-pro-image-preview, gemini-3-pro-preview, gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview, gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview and 6 more (pluxy model list shows them all). Set the tool's model to one of them, or add a model alias to an account so that "corpus-not-in-catalog" goes to one of them.
